Headline: Win €500,000 this holiday season: every euro you deposit is an entry

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
## TL;DR
- One winner takes €500,000, in the Holiday Deposit Sweepstakes.
- Enroll first in Rewards Hub, then earn 1 entry for every euro you deposit after you enroll.
- The sweepstakes runs from Thursday, November 19, 2026 to Thursday, January 7, 2027, with one draw after it closes.
- Open to eligible Consumer and Pro clients in the US, the EEA and select other regions.
This holiday season, one client wins €500,000. Every euro you deposit is an entry. Enroll, bring your assets to us, and your entries add up until January 7.
Whether you’re moving assets over from another platform or adding to your account with us, the Holiday Deposit Sweepstakes gives you a festive reason to do it now.
## How to enter
- Enroll first via the Kraken app, Kraken Pro app or Kraken Pro web, and opt in. Only deposits made after you enroll count.
- Deposit. Add fiat or crypto, including transfers from other exchanges once credited. Each euro you deposit earns 1 entry. Deposits in other currencies are valued in EUR to determine the number of entries earned. Your actual deposit is not converted.
- Watch your entries add up. Keep depositing until the sweepstakes closes on January 7, 2027, at 2:00 p.m. UTC. Then we draw one winner at random.
## What counts as an entry
Entries are based on the deposits you make after you enroll.
- What counts: fiat and crypto deposits made after you enroll, including transfers from other exchanges once credited.
- What doesn’t: existing balances, deposits made before you enroll, and transfers between your own accounts with us.
- Earning entries: only deposits earn entries. Buying or investing with the assets you deposit doesn’t add more.
- Limits: there’s no minimum deposit, and each client can earn up to 1,000,000 entries.
More entries mean more chances to win, but they never guarantee a win.
## See how entries add up
## Here’s an example of how one client’s entries could grow:
- November 19: Enroll in the Sweepstakes.
- Late November: move €2,000 of crypto from another exchange to Kraken and earn 2,000 entries.
- December: deposit another €500 in fiat, for 2,500 entries in total.
- January: nothing to do. The winner is drawn on January 7, 2027. If you win, €500,000 is on its way.
## Why bring your assets to us
The prize gets you started. These are a few reasons to stay.
For clients in the EEA: we’re MiCA and MiFID authorized since 2025, and we’ve been operating since 2011, with quarterly Proof of Reserves.
- Instant Buy: Purchase 600+ crypto assets in seconds.
- US stocks: Alongside your crypto and xStocks, trade 7,000+ US stocks, all from one account.
Feature availability varies by region.
## Key dates
- Opens: Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. UTC
- Closes: Thursday, January 7, 2027, at 2:00 p.m. UTC
- Draw: Thursday, January 7, 2027
## Who can enter
The sweepstakes is open to eligible Consumer and Pro clients with a verified account in:
- US: 46 states plus Washington D.C. (all states except Florida, Maine, New York and Washington). Puerto Rico is also excluded.
- EEA: all countries excluding Poland and Norway
- Other regions: see the Terms and Conditions for the full list of eligible countries.

Headline: Trade ANTx on Kraken Pro, with $5,000 in prizes

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
## TL;DR
- ANTx is live on Kraken Pro. It gives you price exposure to Anthropic shares, and you trade it from the Kraken Pro account and balance you already use.
- The ANTx trading challenge runs November 20 to November 27, 2026, with $5,000 in USDG prizes ranked by your ANTx/USD spot volume on Kraken Pro. Enroll first: trades placed before you enroll don’t count.
- $500 in qualifying volume puts you in the running. The top 20 traders win ranked prizes of up to $1,000, and every other qualifying trader shares $1,225.
November 19, 2026, was Anthropic’s first trading day, and ANTx is now live on Kraken Pro. You can trade it from the account you already have, right alongside your crypto.
To give you a reason to trade it this week, we’re running an ANTx trading challenge with $5,000 in prizes, starting November 20.
## Trade ANTx from day one
ANTx is a tokenized asset that tracks the price of Anthropic shares. When you trade ANTx, you’re trading the token, not the underlying Anthropic stock.
It trades from the same Kraken Pro account and balance you already use, so there’s no second account to open and no transfer to another venue.
ANTx is also available in the Kraken app, but only trades on Kraken Pro count toward the challenge. Kraken Pro runs on the same account, so you can switch over without signing up again.
## How the ANTx challenge works
The challenge is ranked by trading volume. Here’s how it runs:
- When: November 20, 2026, to November 27, 2026.
- What counts: your spot volume on the ANTx/USD market on Kraken Pro. Other ANTx pairs and trades in the Kraken app don’t count.
- How to qualify: reach at least $500 in qualifying volume during the challenge.
- Who wins: the top 20 traders by volume take ranked prizes, and every other qualifying trader shares the rest of the pool.
- How prizes are paid: in USDG, after the challenge closes.
## How the $5,000 is split
Rank | Prize per trader | Total
1st | $1,000 | $1,000
2nd | $650 | $650
3rd | $500 | $500
4th and 5th | $250 | $500
6th to 10th | $125 | $625
11th to 20th | $50 | $500
Every other qualifying trader | Shared | $1,225
Total |  | $5,000
The $1,225 is shared among every qualifying trader outside the top 20.
## How to join
Enrollment is the first step. Volume from trades placed before you enroll doesn’t count toward your rank or the $500 minimum.
- Log in to Kraken Pro on the app or web, or sign up if you don’t have an account yet.
- Enroll on the challenge page before your first ANTx trade.
- Trade ANTx/USD on Kraken Pro between November 20 and November 27, 2026.
Using the Kraken Pro app? Update to the latest version so you can enroll.
## Know the costs and hours before you trade
- Fees: ANTx fees are shown before you place an order. See them on the fee schedule.
- Trading hours: check a market’s hours in the Support Center before you trade.
- Rules: the full challenge rules, including eligibility and payouts, are in the terms and conditions.
## Where the markets and the challenge are available
ANTx and the ANTx challenge aren’t available in the US, UK, Canada, or Australia. The challenge isn’t open to EEA clients. Other eligibility restrictions apply.
## Join the challenge
Enroll before your first trade, then trade ANTx/USD on Kraken Pro from November 20 to November 27 for your shot at a share of $5,000 in prizes.
Join the Challenge
Eligibility restrictions apply. The ANTx trading challenge is subject to its terms and conditions.

Headline: Binance Alpha Trading Competition: Trade Pieverse (PIEVERSE) and Share $200K Worth of Rewards (2026-11-20)

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance Wallet is excited to launch the PIEVERSE Trading Competition on Binance Alpha! During the Promotion Periods, trade Pieverse (PIEVERSE) in your Binance Wallet (Keyless) or via Binance Alpha to receive exclusive token rewards. Any user who is eligible to trade Binance Alpha tokens is eligible to participate in this trading competition.
1st PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-20 13:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-27 13:00 (UTC)
2nd PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-27 13:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-04 13:00 (UTC)
## General Rules 
Participants will be ranked according to their total purchase volume on PIEVERSE during the Promotion Period. The top 2,000 users by purchase volume of PIEVERSE tokens during the Promotion Period will share 36,000 PIEVERSE tokens equally (= 18 PIEVERSE per user).
Rewards will now place greater emphasis on early trading and consistent participation during the Promotion Period, making reward distribution fairer, returns clearer, and participation more accessible. To support this, we are introducing the Early Bird Boost Multiplier.
To further encourage broader participation, we are also introducing the Rising Trader Boost Multiplier.
## Early Bird Boost Multiplier
Users can now trade earlier to earn more. In the Promotion Period, earlier trades will receive a higher multiplier, which boosts a user’s base trading volume.
## Daily Effective Trading Volume is calculated as follows:
Daily Effective Trading Volume = Actual Trading Volume * Early Bird Boost Multiplier
Note: Total trading volume for the competition is the sum of daily effective trading volume during the Promotion Period.
Users’ base trading volume generated during the following days in the Promotion Period will receive the corresponding multiplier when calculating their rankings:
Trading Day | Eligible Date and Time (UTC) | Multiplier
Day 1 | 1st PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-20 13:00 to 2026-11-21 13:00 and 2nd PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-27 13:00 to 2026-11-28 13:00 | 3.0x
Day 2 | 1st PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-21 13:00 to 2026-11-22 13:00 and 2nd PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-28 13:00 to 2026-11-29 13:00 | 3.0x
Day 3 | 1st PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-22 13:00 to 2026-11-23 13:00 and 2nd PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-29 13:00 to 2026-11-30 13:00 | 2.5x
Day 4 | 1st PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-23 13:00 to 2026-11-24 13:00 and 2nd PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-30 13:00 to 2026-12-01 13:00 | 2.0x
Day 5 | 1st PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-24 13:00 to 2026-11-25 13:00 and 2nd PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-12-01 13:00 to 2026-12-02 13:00 | 1.8x
Day 6 | 1st PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-25 13:00 to 2026-11-26 13:00 and 2nd PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-12-02 13:00 to 2026-12-03 13:00 | 1.3x
Day 7 | 1st PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-26 13:00 to 2026-11-27 13:00 and 2nd PIEVERSE Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-12-03 13:00 to 2026-12-04 13:00 | 1.0x
## Rising Trader Boost Multiplier
For the purpose of this Promotion, “Rising Traders” refers to users who, as of three days before the start of the Promotion Period, have won any rewards in fewer than 3 previous Binance Wallet’s Alpha trading competitions.
Eligible Rising Traders will receive a 1.2x Rising Trader Boost on their actual trading volume during the Promotion Period, subject to a Rising Trader Boost Cap.
## Notes:
The "Rising Trader" qualification is determined as of three days before the activity period begins.
For example, if a user wins a trading competition ending on Day T, and their cumulative historical win count reaches exactly 3 at that point, they will still qualify as a Rising Trader for new competitions starting on T+1 and T+2 (since the qualification snapshot was taken before their 3rd win). However, for competitions starting on T+3 and beyond, their historical win count will already be 3 or more at the qualification snapshot, and they will no longer be eligible for the Rising Trader bonus.
The Rising Trader Boost Cap refers to the maximum actual trading volume that can receive the Rising Trader Boost during the Promotion Period. Once a user’s Rising Trader Boost Cap has been reached, the user will no longer receive Rising Trader Boosts for any subsequent trading volume.
If both the Early Bird Boost Multiplier and Rising Trader Boost apply, Effective Trading Volume will be calculated as follows:
Effective Trading Volume = Actual Trading Volume * Early Bird Boost Multiplier + min(Actual Trading Volume, Remaining Rising Trader Boost Cap) * Rising Trader Boost
The final ranking will be calculated based on users’ total Effective Trading Volume during the Promotion Period. A user’s total Effective Trading Volume is the sum of their daily Effective Trading Volume during the Promotion Period.
## Example:
User A generates 10,000 USDT in actual trading volume on Day 1. The Day 1 Early Bird Boost Multiplier is 3.0x, and User A is also eligible for the 1.2x Rising Trader Boost. The Rising Trader Boost Cap is 5,000 USDT.
User A's Day 1 Effective Trading Volume is calculated as follows:
Early Bird Boost: 10,000 * 3.0 = 30,000 USDT
Rising Trader Boost: User A's actual trading volume (10,000 USDT) exceeds the Rising Trader Boost Cap (5,000 USDT), so only 5,000 USDT is eligible for the Rising Trader Boost = 5,000 * 1.2 = 6,000 USDT
Day 1 Effective Trading Volume = 30,000 + 6,000 = 36,000 USDT

## What Is a Prediction Market?
A prediction market lets participants trade on the outcome of a future event. Each market asks a clearly defined question and offers outcomes such as “Yes” and “No.”
The price of each outcome reflects the market’s current implied probability. For example, a “Yes” price of 0.65 suggests the market currently assigns about a 65% chance to that outcome. It is a market view, not a guarantee.
## What Can You Trade on KuCoin Predictions?
KuCoin Predictions gives eligible users access to supported Polymarket markets within the KuCoin App. Market categories include:
Crypto: Trade on cryptocurrency price movements.
Sports: Trade on the outcomes of sporting events.
Politics: Trade on the outcomes of political events.
Crypto Up or Down markets support BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, DOGE, and HYPE, with 5-minute, 15-minute, and 4-hour intervals. Check the App for the specific asset and interval combinations currently available to you.
Each market has its own question, time window, and settlement rules. Read them carefully before trading. Available markets are subject to regional and account eligibility.
## How Does a Trade Work?
Buying 10 “Yes” shares at an average price of $0.65 costs $6.50 before fees. In a normally resolved market:
If “Yes” wins, those shares settle for $10 in total, giving a gross profit of $3.50 before fees.
If “No” wins, those shares settle at $0, and the $6.50 is lost.
You may also be able to sell before settlement, depending on market status, liquidity, and applicable price protection.
KuCoin provides the in-app interface and account functions. Polymarket provides the underlying markets, rules, prices, liquidity, order execution, and outcome resolution. KuCoin does not independently determine market outcomes.

Headline: Gate Research: An Overlooked Profitable Sector: Scale, Competition, and Moat in the Onchain TCG Card...

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Beyond perpetual DEXs, meme launchpads, prediction markets, and trading terminals, the onchain TCG card market is often overlooked, yet it has grown into a profitable niche with more than $300 million in monthly volume. Drawing on Blockworks data, this report breaks down gacha spend and secondary-market volume, compares platforms such as Collector Crypt and Courtyard across user scale, average ticket, buyback rates, payment methods, and liquidity, and examines the sector's scale, competition, and moats.
The findings show a market that has proven demand but not yet proven durable profitability. Volume is concentrated in two platforms, profits are concentrated in two different ways, and the real barriers sit in inventory, distribution, and procurement rather than in trading.
## Key Takeaways:
- The onchain TCG card market has grown from near zero in August 2023 to $343 million in monthly volume in October 2026, with about $2.32 billion in the first ten months of 2026. Gacha spend dominates; secondary-market volume is only 3.5% of gacha spend.
- Over the past 30 days, Collector Crypt generated $12.3 million in net revenue, above GMGN's $5.4 million and approaching Polymarket's $18.4 million. But U.S. pack-ripping apps handle about $2.22 billion a month and eBay card sales are about $633 million, so onchain TCG remains small.
- Competition is a duopoly: by 30-day gacha spend, Collector Crypt holds 64.5% and Courtyard 24.5%, for a combined 89%; the other three account for about 10.9%. By net revenue, Courtyard leads with 53% and Collector Crypt accounts for about 41%, so volume share and profit share are not the same.
- The two leaders represent different models. Collector Crypt runs an issuance-and-market-making model: a $237 average pack price, a 93.6% implied buyback rate, 14 partner entry points, and CARDS incentives, with 0.65% of wallets contributing 57.8% of spend. Courtyard runs a retail-and-retention model: a $78 average pack price, a 77.8% implied buyback rate, 6,000 to 8,000 daily active wallets, and 32.07% credit-card penetration.
- The real moats sit on the issuance side: independent liquidity, distribution, and procurement and pricing. The sector still faces category concentration, buyback-flywheel, token-unlock, regulatory, and custody risks. Its longer-term value may lie less in pack opening itself than in turning grading, custody, pricing, and settlement into reusable infrastructure.
